info.name: Planview AgilePlace API (LeanKit) v2 account token-auth API
Get the list of authentication tokens

items.docs: Get the list of authentication tokens. You can also manage your tokens by choosing the "My API Tokens" tab in your LeanKit User Profile.

Create an authentication token. Make sure that you choose a meaningful description when you post, and record the token received from this request. This is the only time it is displayed. You can also manage your tokens by choosing the "My API Tokens" tab in your LeanKit User Profile.
Delete an authentication token. You can also manage your tokens by choosing the "My API Tokens" tab in your LeanKit User Profile.
